nom: No7 Radiance+ Bright Eye Roll-on Eye Cream

avis.texte: Has micro glitter which is not wearable for daily use and pills off.

This product has roller ball application which feels nice but the product that comes out, another story. It does not moisturize, brighten or blend out. It is an orange color I would assume from vit C which would be great if it didn't pill on your skin and wipe off.

I bought this to replace my first aid beauty eye cream that has been discontinued. I wanted something to slightly brighten undereyes on days where i was not wearing makeup. This has actual sparkles in the product. Looks very obvious and strange on the skin.

avis.titre: Pills up on skin, very orange
avis.texte: This product was extremely disappointing. I literally can't even use it because it's immediately pills up on my skin and does not absorb. I try to rub it in and it just pills and flakes right off. Also it is like orange orange. This cannot be used under makeup. Very disappointed

I have SEVERE dark circles so I wasn't surprised when I didn't see a difference but that's okay. It felt nice. I like the rollerball concept but one would have been better than three. Three didn't contour the eye very well.

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this product again
avis.texte: I just started using this so I don't see any results yet but I know it takes time to see the difference.

avis.titre: A good idea that still needs work
avis.texte: The 3 massaging balls in the applicator need to be "triggered" gently by your fingers. The amount of cover up make-up which comes out is uneven. Also, that color of make-up is not what I would have chosen for me! I am still waiting for the radiance benefits I am supposed to see in my face.

avis.titre: I loved this roll-on eye treatment!
avis.texte: I absolutely loved my No7 Radiance+ Brght Eye Roll-On eye treatment! After using it for a couple of weeks now, I can say that this is top tier when it comes to brightening tired-looking eyes! I love the squeeze-tube that it comes in with the 3 roller balls at the end. It's very satisfying and cooling below the eye, and helps to de-puff my eyes and makes my under-eye area look brighter and more awake! Even though the 3 roll-on balls are of a kind of metal material, they do NOT tug or pull on your skin--it is actually very gentle and relaxing. Not only that, but I actually find the whole experience quite relaxing. If you want to brighten and de-puff your under-eye areas, this cream with Vitamin C, color-correcting pigments and caffeine, this No7 Radiance+ Roll & Glow Eye Cream might be for you! At about $14, I find this eye cream very affordable and comparable to my Keihl's Vitamin C Eye Cream!! I will be repurchasing this item and I highly recommend anyone to but this No7 eye cream!

avis.titre: Great eye roll on, use at night!
avis.texte: I use this eye cream at night - it's that typical orange-y color of things that utilize vitamin C. I like the targeted applicator - I keep this in the fridge for a nice refreshing boost to my eyes. I think you could use it during the morning if you are willing to wipe it away, but I like to let it sit on my skin so I can wake up looking refreshed :)

I was super excited to try this eye cream as I have really dark circles due to chronic insomnia/lack of sleep/poor sleep. I REALLY hoped to love this... However, although it moisturized the area around my eyes AND did brighten the dark circles a little bit, I would have preferred this to be more tinted so as to hide more of the darkness. I think it should have been thicker too/more moisturizing. In my opinion I think this would be more suitable for younger skin/more oily/less dehydrated/less dark circles.

The roll on applicator is genius! So easy to use, feels like it instantly brightens up my under eye area and the puffiness magically disappears. The coolness of the roller ball is awesome. Will definitely be buying this in the future.

I started using this roll on and right away I started seeing results. My under eyes and sides of my eye started to look smoother and bright. I received many compliments about my face and eyes. This will be something I am going to continue.

I've always been super insecure about how puffy my eyes are from lack of sleep and from stress. After I started using this two/three times a day I noticed the puffiness was going away quickly! I love it so much and it's one of my favorite skincare purchases in a long time :) Super easy to apply and the applicator feels nice and cool on my undereye skin which is rejuvenating. Doesn't irritate my skin either. If you have dark circles or a "puffy eye" issue, give this a try. It worked wonderfully for me, and I hope it does for you too!

avis.titre: Looks good on, No different without
avis.texte: I received the No7 Radiance + Bright Eye Roll on and was super excited to try it. I have bags under my eyes every morning when I wake up. The roll on has three metal balls that is supposed to help put the product on, but it doesn't do much. You still have to smooth the product onto your skin afterwards. I didn't really see much of an improvement in how the bags under my eyes looked after several weeks of using the product. BUT, when you put it on first thing in the morning, it does give your face a pick me up because the color of the product takes away any dark bags that you would normally see. It also feels refreshing after putting it on. Top image in the picture is before use, bottom image is after weeks of use.

I've used No7 brand skincare before to review & loved it & this lived up to the rest. It was light.. non great made my eyes feel hydrated & comfortable. I wore it it makeup & alone & the results were pretty good with my foundation. I did see some creasing & patches but it could be my application. I still love the brand & would buy & recommend.

I love the three rollerballs. Very neat idea and very soothing around the eye area. It's slightly tinted which helps conceal and brighten. It makes my under eyes look so healthy and bright. I love this brand.

pros- metal tip applicator feels super cooling. doesn't make my under eyes feel sensitive or burn. cons- if you push the slightest bit too hard, you will get an abundance of product that you don't need. I really enjoy it and feel as if i'm starting to see a decrease of the darkness around my eyes!

Very good makes the puffiness go away and makes your eyes look youthful.. it's a gold shimmer the three rollers feel good rolling and massaging your eyes I highly recommend to any of my aging friends..
Very smooth and relaxing to the eye area. Great product. I do not wear makeup so I can't comment on how it wears under but by itself, it is amazing! Try it!

This bright eye roll on is soothing to my undereyes. It absorbs well and does not leave the skin oily like other brands. There was some noticeable in my under eye bags and coloring improvements but the sample size was not large enough for a little longer use. I will be purchasing this to see if there is continued improvement.

I like the coolness of the metal rolling balls and the product absorbs fairly easily. The orange color threw me off but may be what kind of helps brighten I guess. I like that there isn't an obvious odor and seems to brighten up the area under my eyes

This is a really nice tinted eye cream, which at first made me a little skeptical to be honest, because sometimes tinted eye creams ten to pill or be a little thick. This one however is super lightweight and gets absorbed into the skin really well, while leaving a light peach color behind. It doesn't substitute a concealer but it is nice to have a tiny bit extra help there. It has 3 metal circles which makes it very nice on the under eye, especially if you put in then fridge. And finally, it has really nice ingredients, which makes me be extremely happy with this eye cream. It has vitamin c, caffeine, peptides, and panthenol! I mean… this is my current favorite eye cream!!

I like the consistency and I like how My skin drinks it up under my eyes but to be honest I haven't seen any difference in any results also it doesn't feel hydrating it doesn't feel like it's doing anything doesn't make it seem firmer is just applied on to be honest
I really didn't think it would be so soft and gentle. And it even smelled good! For oily skin...it's a must have!

I received this product as a free sample to try. The cream goes on easily and absorbs pretty quickly, but I did use my fingertip to make sure it was evenly distributed. The rollers stay cold so it helps soothe the skin under your eyes. After a couple uses I noticed the puffiness went almost completely away and my eyes looked brighter. The skin seems smoother and moisturized. I look more refreshed.
This is a great product! My undereye area has brightened up. It is so easy to apply with the roller balls. I plan to buy again!!!
I absolutely loved the experience using N07 Radiance+ Brght eyeroll on, I used in the morning and at night and within a couple days i noticed a much more glowful look to my eyes

So I consider myself a skin care product enthusist. I love trying new products! I have products that range from drugstore brands to high-end luxury brands. I just like products that work! Eye creams can be a huge miss in my experience. There are very few eye products that have blown me away. This is absolutely the best vitamin C eye serum, I have ever used. It has gained its place in my daily routine. First, the packaging with the rolling ball is the perfect applicator for an eye cream. The rollers allow you to glide the product on your eyes without tugging on the skin, they also help reduce undereye circles and puffiness. The formula's color-correcting tint reduces the blue circles under my eyes and creates a great base for makeup ( but it also makes my circles look good enough that I don't mind leaving w/o makeup). These are just the instant results, but after using this product for over a month now it has greatly reduced the discoloration, puffiness, and even my fine lines. I can't say enough about this eye cream. The cherry on top is that it's affordable! No 7 proves you don't have to spend a fortune to get skincare products that work!! Please never stop making this product and never change the formula!!

I am actually more impressed with this eye serum than I even expected to be! I love the little roller that massages my eyes and I swear this is so helpful to helping depict my eyes. Infoseek to notice this "erases" my fine lines and definitely brightens up my eye areas. The tint is nice but I want to look for the same version without tint for nighttime as I hate any kind of makeup when I sleep. All in all I am very thrilled with this eye roller and will keep it in my daily beauty routines!
I love when my eye cream or serums are in an easy roll on or stick form. This was very easy to apply to my under eyes. I also felt like I noticed brightness from using this.

I was chosen as a Bzz agent to review the No7 Radiance+ Brght Eye Roll-On 15ml in exchange for a free sample. I used the No7 Radiance+ Brght Eye Roll-On 15ml for approximately 2 weeks this is my review. After using the No7 Radiance+ Brght Eye Roll-On 15ml for 2 weeks I didn't notice any super significant changes in the brightness department, but I did however notice my under eyes were much more moisturized and softer looking. I kept this in my refrigerator so the applicator tip felt nice and cool when applying. I found the applicator to be difficult to apply directly on the eyes, so I had to apply it on my finger tip and dab it onto the bottom of my eye. A little bit definitely goes along way and I found being that I am fair skin that it took a lot of rubbing to get that orangey color to really blend in to my skin. I found that the orange tint never really blended into my skin completely, and was unable to use this into my morning routine so was only able to use the No7 Radiance+ Brght Eye Roll-On 15ml at night. For this reason alone and for the sheer fact that I really didn't notice much brightness an improvement on puffiness I wouldn't fully recommend the No7 Radiance+ Brght Eye Roll-On 15ml to others, Nor would I purchase it in the future.

avis.titre: It feels nice, but I didnt see a difference
avis.texte: I really enjoyed applying this by rollerballs, but I just didnt see any change to my under eye. It felt nice going on, and there is a little cooling sensation. But thats it. I didnt see any change with puffiness.

It is easy to roll on. It dispenses the product easily as you roll. It is a slight cool feeling as you roll. It absorbs quickly into the skin. I have noticed fewer lines and smoother wrinkles around the eyes. And my skin looks brighter.

I love trying new eye creams, especially ones that are meant to heal my dark circles. I love the applicator on this eye cream! It feels so cooling and refreshing under the eye. The size is very generous and I know this will last a long time! Overall, I'm really enjoying this eye cream. Great consistency, not too thick or thin and it has reacted well with my skin

avis.titre: Lightened my dark circles and reduced puffy eyes
avis.texte: I received this product free for testing. I have used several lightning treatments meant to revitalize, puffy, eyes, and lighten dark circles. I really enjoyed the metal balls that allow me to massage my under eyes and lighten the dark circles, it is slightly better than some of the other products I have used in the past, depending on how pale your skin is, mine is very pale. It does work somewhat better than some of the other top products, and really helps bring down puffy eyes after a rough day. I would recommend this product for olive or darker skin.
The No7 Radiance and Bright Eye Roll was easy to apply. It made my undereye area brighter and look more awake. Would definitely recommend.

avis.titre: Helps with the puffy eyes and dark circles
avis.texte: I love that in my routine before going to work, everything that is so time consuming that didn't fully work to help with my puffy, tired eyes, No 7 radiance+ roll and glow eye cream helps me even on 4 hours of sleep. I can appear to go into work bright eyed anyhow. This little tube is convenient if you're in a hurry, and a little goes a long way. I live the 3 roller balls that are metal and cool that instantly get to work on the puffiness. I highly recommend No 7 radiance+ roll and glow eye cream.

avis.titre: Good product, very happy with it
avis.texte: No.7 Radiance + Bright Eye Roll On worked well I was pleasantly surprised how well the light tint blended very well. under my eyes looked much better after using this for awhile. The only thing is the roller balls would stick once in awhile and had to spread with my finger but no big deal. Will be buying this product

The No7 Radiance+ Brght Eye Roll-On is just an okay product in my opinion. I enjoy the cooling effects of the rollers and the product feels good on. It absorbs quickly and isn't sticky or greasy at all. However, I have been using it frequently and do not really notice much of a difference in the appearance of my eye area.

I had high hopes for this eye cream which unfortunately didn't quite live up to expectations. First the good. I love the applicator! The roller balls are cooling and feel great on tired morning eyes! I have very sensitive skin and had no issues with the cream irritating my eyes. The downside. I used it exclusively for several weeks and saw no improvement around the eye area. My eyes benefited from the cooling roller balls more than the product (I tested it one day just using an applicator without the cream). The tint in the product did temper the dark circles, but unfortunately, anywhere it was applied outside of the dark areas left my skin with a strange tint and the glitter in the product did no favors. Overall, I think it is an average product that just didn't quite live up to the promises.

This definitely helps dark circles around your eyes. It has vitamins c and color correcting pigments. You basically squeeze the tube and roll it under an around your eyes. There are 3 balls that help roll it under your eyes. ( See pic below)

I love this eye roll on cream. It is really easy to use and comes in a very nice tube. As compared to the other eye creams I have uses this is definitely one of the best ones. The moment you roll it under your eye it provides a cooling and soothing sensation. I do have puffe eyes in the morning after I wake up and this definitely helps correct it and soothes it. It has tri ball rollers that makes it easy to apply but you have to be a little gentle while applying pressure. It is a little tinted and definitely makes your under eye a little shiny and not dull.

avis.titre: Great eye cream for morning routines
avis.texte: I LOVE a great eye cream. The puffy, dark spots under my eyes are one of the things I think age me the most, so I'm always hunting for something that will help spring my eyes back to life. I tried this for a few days right out of my makeup bag and a few days in my skincare fridge and while I'm not sure I SAW much difference between the two, rolling on this cream when it was chilled felt so luxurious, I do think after about 5 days of twice daily use my eyes did feel great and look a little more rested. The brightening of this roll-on made me feel better right away because I could see a little glow right as I was rolling this on. I like that a little seems to go a long way, so you'll be some bang for your buck with this tube, which is a huge plus for me. This product will likely find its way into my morning routine at least a few days a week. For nighttime I would still prefer a night-specific firming eye cream but this roll-on held up to my standards during the trial period.

avis.titre: Works well to brighten under eyes
avis.texte: I really enjoyed using this product! It's easy to use--just squeeze the tube a little, then roll on under your eyes. The little metal balls made it feel like a spa treatment. It is sightly tinted to help decrease the appearance of dark circles. I found it pretty effective in doing so! Overall I really like this product and would recommend it.
I tried this product and it reduced my dark circles and buffy eyes. I really loved the roll on applicator. It was not greasy it all. Definitely buy this product for regular use

I love this product because it helps brighten my under eyes and make it look like I have gotten a lot of sleep. The product helps to roll and glow quickly and easily. It doesn't have a scent or at least a strong one. My favorite thing about it is the rolly balls inside that help to evenly distribute the product under your eyes. No finger tips needed. I used my beauty blender to blend in. It provided some coverage. You may not need concealer if you use this. The product didn't seem cakey, which was a plus. I will definitely continue to use this product in my daily makeup routine.

Dark circles are the bane of my existence. I am a third shift worker and always searching for an instant fix for my dark circles and bags. I especially love popping this tube in the fridge and using it cold. It feels great and really does have a great brightening effect on my under eyes.

Under eye circles is one of my enemies in life and this is the first time ive seen something worked! I love how it glides over my skin and it surprisingly has made it brighter in as little as one week. I highly recommend this!

This product was easy to use, had a tinge of sparkle but I didn't really notice any brightening or smoothing. I did like the rolling tip application, as it did massage the undereye area. But other than that, I'm not sure it's a product I would tell my friends is a must have!!
Wow this roll on is amazing..! Puffiness gone, bright eyes, bags gone, dark circles gone ..!
Easy, smooth application. Left my skin feeling rejuvenated and fresh. Can already see a difference in firming the skin under my eyes. Will continue using this product and would recommend!
I love this this product I got. It's very smooth under my eye and I do see a difference than before. Less darkness and light brighter.
I would recommend using No7 Radiance + it helped reduce my dark circles under my eyes. I did however notice than when I stopped they seemed to have come back.
I used this product for about 2 weeks, 2x a day morning and night and while I saw no significant difference it was a nice product and felt nice on my skin

First, I love the idea of this product. I didn't like how the product comes out of this tube, like it's almost too liquidy for this packaging. There is also an orange tint so this so you have to spend some (extra) time blending it into your skin. Not sure if it's made my under eyes brighter after using it for several weeks so far.
I received the No7 Radiance+ Brght Eye Roll-On as a free sample to try. It goes on really easy and the rollers are very soothing to your eyes. It did seem to lessen my dark circles under my eyes.

I like this product because the roll on applicator makes applying it easy. The product has a slight tint to it. It hydrates the eye area well and feels nice when applying the product. I have used the product for a couple of weeks and I haven't seen a difference. It does not brighten the skin and it hasn't concealed my dark circles. I think overall it's a good product for a reasonable price but if your looking to brighten your eye area and conceal dark circles buy something else.

I've seen noticeable improvement in how much brighter and tighter my eye area looks since using the Radiance+ Roll and Glow Eye cream. I love the applicator and how you can massage the product into the under eye area. The pigmented cream helps to color correct, and the vitamin c and caffeine really brightens up the eye area.

I have used this product for a week now and am starting to see some results. I just turned 40 and have been noticing lots of dark circles. This has helped to slow that down, even reverse that. I'm excited to see where it continues to go.

I honestly didn't love this eye cream. The design of the roller tube makes it so you can't get a proper, even amount out. It was always too much or too little and the roller balls didn't feel like they moved. Because the packaging was so bad, it was hard to tell if the product itself was really any good because I couldn't use correct amounts. Instead, it pilled up under my eye area and had no effect I could notice.
In a short time I've noticed subtle changes in my skin. Smoother and brighter.

I enjoyed using this product. I particularly loved the three roller balls, as they soothed my tired under eye. The actual formal is pretty thin, and comes out a light orange with sparkles on it. Very similar to the murad brightening eye cream. Give it a try!
This is really moisturizing while not being sticky or leaving residue. It really does brighten up the underwhelmed, making your skin look more awake
This product really did help my undereye area. I look more hydrated.

No7 is a great drugstore brand with alot of great products. The radiance bright eye roll on is good but not my favorite eye cream. I love the roll on applicator. It allows for easy application but I didnt notice any Brightening effects over the last few weeks. I do like that the formula includes vitamin c and caffeine which is great for depuffing and Brightening but both ingredients are further down in the ingredient list so theres likely not alot of it in the formula. Overall, its a decent product that gives the under eye area some hydration but thats about it.

I am already a fan of No. 7 products and this did not disappoint! You give it a little squeeze to get the product to the rollers and then apply it gently with rollers gently massaging the tender skin under the eyes. After a couple of weeks of using it, I noticed a visible difference in the fine lines forming under and beside my eyes and less of a raccoon look when I don't get enough sleep. My favorite part, if you haven't already guessed, are the tiny little rollers that massage the skin .
I received this as a free sample. I found it a little awkward to use. I would have liked it better if the tip were smaller. It was a little hard to apply. The color was a good match.

I didn't really feel like the rolling feature was useful. I would try to roll it onto my eye area, but then would have to back back over it with my finger because the roller didn't do a good job of evenly applying the product.

I used this for a couple weeks now, and i have noticed that my under-eyes are much brighter. I look less tired and more refreshed. I am very pleased with this product. The only thing that i think could use some work, is that it doesn't squeeze out the best.

After using this for a while I didn't notice any super significant changes in the brightness department. I did however notice my under eyes were much more moisturized and softer looking. I kept this in my beauty fridge so the applicator tip felt cold amazing when applying. Overall, I loved the results.

avis.titre: Could be better, and very orange
avis.texte: I'm mixed about this product -- I am a big believer in vitamin C-based products, however, for an undereye cream I found that this didn't absorb that well. I really had to rub using the rollers for a while, which isn't great for the delicate undereye area. It was also jarring that the cream is literally orange (so again, you REALLY need to rub it in), and I think the color might be what lends towards appearing like there is an improvement, but I didn't actually notice a difference after using it for 2 weeks.

I really loved the cooling effect of the roller all application. This was a wonderful and soothing effect to any puffiness. I also liked the eye cream. It had a bit of tint but seems like it blends well with any skin tone and leaves a nice glow that brightens the area. What I disliked is that either to little or too much product would come out and you would have to blend any excess with your ring finger.
I started using it every morning and I love that rollers stay cold. It does brighten my under-eye area. My skin also stays smooth.

avis.titre: An Eye Cream that Brightens and Tightens!
avis.texte: The No7 Roll and Glow Eye Cream exceeded all my expectations! It is one of the rare skincare products that my husband and I both love because we have dramatically different skin types. It is intensely hydrating without being greasy or causing my eye makeup to crease. It reduces the puffiness around my undereye area, and lightens the dark circles around my husband's. It feels so refreshing to apply directly from the built in roller applicator. The coldness feels incredible and it spreads the product evenly. This is one of the rare products that I can confidently recommend to everyone.
I'm really impressed with the way this has left my under eye area feel. It really has made a difference in appearance and texture. It makes my under eyes feel nice and cool and smooth.

No7 Radiance+ Bright Eye Roll-On is a wonderful addition to my daily routine! I suffer from puffy and dark under eyes from wearing glasses and looking at a computer screen and needed something to help take care of the sunken eye look. No7 Radiance helps take care of that problem. I've broken down into pros and cons so: Pro: Tinted cream with a brightening sparkle; easily spreads with the rollers to blend in; left my skin moisturized with a dewey look; lightly scented; notable filled out under eyes after a week's use. Cons: Pressing the rollers to under the eye to get the cream to come out; too much gets ejected from the holes if you press too hard but not enough if you gently push. I suggest pressing it on your hand first to get the right amount. Overall, No7 Radiance+ Bright Eye Roll-On is something I will continue to use to keep my eyes looking their best. Light cover up with just enough sparkle.

I've used this product in the past so I'm glad I got to try it out again I forgot how great it works! The metal on the top really helps with puffiness and the orange with helps with darkness under the eyes.
I used this product for a couple weeks. It is easy to use and the roll on ball feels nice and cool on my skin. However, I haven't seen any difference in my eyes.

I am starting to show fine lines around my eyes, and have somewhat dark circles. I've used this roll-on AM & PM for a couple weeks, and I am seeing a difference! The skin around my eyes is softer, the dark circles are lighter, and the fine lines aren't as visible. And I love that it has a tint to it, as well.

The texture, smell and creaminess of this eye cream is amazing. I love the cold roller balls. I put mine in the fridge so the roller balls are cold and help even more with my puffy under eye bags. I've only tried this for a couple weeks and see some results but I'm sure I'll see more over time.

No7 Radiance+ Roll & Go Eye Cream is a lightly tinted eye cream enriched with vitamin C and caffeine that instantly brightens the skin under your eyes. It comes in a tube with a tri-ball roller on the end. This makes it very easy to apply and the little metal balls are soothing and cooling. I really love how this makes my skin feel and look. With the light tint, it helps to cover up my dark circles under my eyes. It truly lightens and brightens my skin, making it look radiant. It is a great way to reduce puffiness under my eyes too. I feel like people are looking at me and not my dark, tired eyes now. I love No7 Radiance+

I used this product for a couple of weeks and I honestly didnt notice a huge difference in the brightness around my eyes. I really like the application tho, it was a different roller system then I have seen or used in the past.

No7 Radiance+Bright Eye Roll-On is literally so "cool" to apply! The tri-ball metal roller truly relaxes the eyes with a cooling effect and just feels so nice on your skin. The cream is tinted so it blends very well with your skin. I have not noticed too much of a difference yet in my under eye area, but it's only been 2 weeks so I'm going to keep using it!

I have used this for a few weeks and I love it! It reduces dark circles and puffiness. No overpowering smell and I really like the roller balls on the applicator. It feels so good! I will definitely buy this when I run out.
I have been using this 1-2 times a day and besides he nice, cool rollers that delivers the cream it leaves zero residue. It works great for the dark under my eyes and just feels refreshing!

I find the cooling ball tip applicator very relaxing on my eyes. It has a little pop of color that makes dark circles look less visible. My eyes look more awake after use. Remember to pat it in as it can leave a bit of residue on skin. I received this complimentary for my honest review.
I could definitely tell a difference after using this for a week! Made my dark circles diminish greatly!
I found this product to work well. It hid my dark shadows and plumped up my eyes. It was very easy to use and worked quickly.

This roll-on eye cream is nice. Very liquid and tinted. It comes in a roller applicator and glides on nicely. The eye cream absorbs quickly and hydrates fine. The issue is that it doesn't brighten as claimed. I don't see a difference before and after using this product for a week. If you're looking for a decent eye product, this works. Just don't expect changes in appearance.
I recived this product as a sample and I tried it for 7 days. I really don't see the difference, Moisturize a little and scent is ok.maybe work in other but not me.

I have been using number seven products for many years now. I've always been very pleased with them. The radiant bright I roll on eye cream is no exception. It feels nice rolling on with the little metal rollers. It come out a cream/yellow color that can be brightening. Make applies nicely on top. Overall very nice product!

This product has a unique roll-on applicator, making it easy to use, and gentle enough for undereye application. The formula is light and creamy, and absorbs well into the skin. It gives a nice cooling effect as well, which feels fantastic! I do notice after an hour or so, the formula gets cakey and looks orange. For this reason, I don't suggest using it beneath concealer or other makeup products. I have been using the No7 Radiance + Eye Cream for a month, and I have seen slight improvement in my dark undereye circles. Additionally, my undereye skin doesn't appear as creapy.
I feel like since using this I've seen some benefits but it is a little heavy on the skin

I've been using this eye roller for 3 weeks now and it's absolutely amazing. I use it every morning and my under eye bags are looking much younger, more moisturized and refreshed looking than ever before! I've been telling everyone I know about this amazing little tube! My husband has even been using it regularly. Definitely going into my regular beauty routine!

After using it for only few days I already noticed a difference around my eyes. Its a great product and doesn't make my eye area feel heavy or greasy. I have tried other products but they do not compare to this eye roll-on.

I have been using this bright eye roll-on in the morning and evening. I am very pleased with the results. The eye cream is easy to apply and very soothing. After applying in the morning it immediately wakes up my eyes. I have noticed a decrease puffiness and my under eye area looks so much brighter.
This product provides a nice cooling effect that will help to de-puff eyes! It also has a tint which helps with bags and any discoloration. It's easy to apply and seems to last awhile!

avis.titre: I could see the results only after few uses
avis.texte: After the first two days trying the No. 7 Radiance Roll and Glow eye cream I could see that the darkness underneath my eyes got brighter. I kept using the No. 7 Radiance Roll and Glow eye cream day and nigth, and i had to start applying it with my fingers, because it bothered me when applied with the tree small rollers that came include with the cream. So I had to start pressing the tube with my fingers, so I could apply the No. 7 Radiance Roll and Glow eye cream on my eyes. It has a faint citrus smell that it really does not bother me. I think that I would keep buying the No. 7 Radiance Roll and Glow eye cream and i know now that I will have apply the cream with my fingers. I would recommend the No. 7 Radiance Roll and Glow eye cream to my friends and family. I am definitely happy with the No. Radiance Roll and Glow eye cream results. I got it for free In exchange for my honest review.
I love how quickly this product visible blends into the skin without leaving any residue. Leaves your under eyes bright and radiant.

I love that this product helps lighten dark undereye circles without accentuating the wrinkles! It is super light weight, brightening and helps reduce puffiness! It's effective without costing a fortune!

After weeks of using the No7 Radiance+ Brght Eye Roll-On, unfortunately there were no differences under my eyes. I've used products were I would see results in matter of couple of days, this wasn't the case. When applying the product it wouldn't mix well with my moisturizer. It didn't hydrate under my eyes and the chunky glitter is a bit concerning. I like the concept of the design of the tube but overall, this product did not work for me.

I have dark circles due to sinuses and other health issues and they do not lighten up for anything, however, upon trying this roll on I can say that I feel a soothing sensation when applied to my under eye area. It rolls in smoothly and feels great on my skin. It gives a spa treatment feel right in your home. I will definitely continue to use it

avis.titre: No7 Roll on wasnt my fav
avis.texte: I had really high hopes for this product. Its a good size and the concept of it being rolled on really seemed like a great idea so i wouldnt even have to touch the product. But it takes a bit to get the tube started which i was okay with but then everytime i tried to use it after so much just came pouring out when i started to roll it and its very thin liquid so it goes everywhere and then i had to wipe it off. i ended up just using it with my finger instead of the stated application but i didnt find it did much. it adds like a nice glitter/sheen under your eye but i didnt find that it did anything else and it kind of dried out my skin which is the opposite of what i wanted it to do. All in all, i would not use this again. #gotitfree #freesample.
I love the applicator of this and I keep it in my fridge for a depuffing effect. The cream is slightly tinted which helps conceal darkness.

This eye roller has helped my skin so much. It has helped reduce the lines under my eyes. I love how easy it glides with its little roller balls. Feels refreshing that wakes up my eyes leaving them bright and refreshed. Made with vitamin C and caffeine that helps reduce puffiness under eyes. This cream is lightweight and dries quickly and leaves skin glowing. Great to use every day during the AM And PM. Just dot around your eyes and gently blend around eyes.

I am thoroughly impressed with how this eye roller works. First, it is incredibly easy to use. You simple press the tube a little bit to prime the roller balls and you roll it on. It has a color corrector in it, as well as, caffeine. Those are both huge pluses for me. It makes my tired eyes look awake again and depuffs really well. You don't need a lot of the product in order for it to work. I have been using this product for a few weeks now and each time I use it, there is a noticeable difference for the better. All together I would highly recommend this product.

avis.titre: This cream seems to be phenomenal!
avis.texte: This is one of the very few eye creams that didn't make my eyes water for hours after use!!!! I truly enjoy the silky, slightly plumped skin feels after using this... I enjoy using it on both the corners of my mouth and around my eyes... One thing I can say that I was going to deduct the stars from is that the rollerball trio ordeal leads to cross contamination, especially with individuals treating HS or cystic acne, etc. However I do like that it easily dispenses on your fingertip as well as it would directly on your face and so you don't have to directly apply it to your skin or near any acne wounds.

I struggle with dark circles and puffiness under my eyes. The no 7 radiance roll and glow eye cream helped brighten my skin and tighten areas under my eye. It was easy to apply and keeps my under eye bright and nourished.

I received No.7 Radiance+ Brght Eye Roll-On 15 ml FOP vis Bzzagent for review. I enjoy using this eye cream. The metal balls on the applicator is refreshing to use. The actual formulation absorbs quickly and leave the skin looking refreshed and brighten without being sparkly. There is a tint to the cream that I wasn't expecting, so do make sure the product is rubbed in completely or it will be noticeable. I haven't noticed any instant changes but I know it can't hurt to continue to use.

I heard of the no 7 brand but hadn't really used any of their products. With that being said, I am pretty impressed with this roll-on brightening cream. I have dark circles under my eyes and this product is something that I needed. It does what it supposed to do. It seems as if it takes away the darkness and also feels as if it's tightening my skin when I use it. My eyes are not so baggy and tired looking as long as I continue riding. Love the cooling applicator. It feels soothing under my eyes. It's something you use day and night and it does take some time but does seem to work. It's worth a try.
This roll on eye cream seems to work really well for me. It goes onto my skin really easily, and it feels nice and cool. It absorbs quickly, and my skin already looks brighter after only a few uses.

I used this eye roll on for two weeks both morning and night. I stored it in my cosmetic fridge so it was cool when I used it. I thought the eye roller provided a nice lightening effect and felt moisturizing. I would purchase it on my own even tho I used it as a free sample.

This eye roller serum has made SUCH a difference on my eyes!! I love it. My eyes look better than they have in a long time. Fine lines? Gone! Bags? Well, not completely gone because I need more sleep but definitely better!!

I have used a lot of different eye products over the years. But have to say I like how this is applied and that it feels good. It glides on easy and I really don't have to put pressure on the tube. Some times I think I feel a little tingle. Have only been using a few weeks don't notice any difference in my under eyes.

avis.titre: Using for a week so far
avis.texte: Been using for a week so far. I like that it rolls on easy and has a nice cold/cooling effect. Easy to apply and don't need to squeeze bottle much to get it out. Can't say I've noticed a lot of difference yet but have enjoyed using this. Will continue to use. Some brightness noted in my undereyes which usually have dark circles

I really enjoyed using this under my eyes but I did feel like I needed an extra moisturizer. That said, the combo of this plus the moisturizer gave me the best result I've ever gotten from a product. I have severely dry skin around my eyes so I usually sacrifice deputing for moisture. Loved using this and receiving those benefits

I was super excited to try out this No7 Radiance+ Bright Eye Roll-On for many reasons. One, I love No7 products. Two, I have been searching for something to impact the the lines and darkness under my eyes. I have used various under eye creams but I never have had great results. This is different. It's a roll on which makes it unique. It rolls on super smoothly and feels refreshing when you use it. After using it, you will see a brighter under eye. I am using it night and day and I can see the improvements. I will definitely keep using this product and rebuy it. I recommend giving it a try.

I love the shape of the bottle, makes it easy to apply. I enjoy using it thanks to the 3 metal rollers. Feels nice, goes on smooth. It seems to be just ok as it does cover well but memes behind a cakey look. My eyes did seem about 20% brighter than they usually look.

I was initially excited to try out this product. Right off the bat, the coolest feature is the little metal roller balls that administer the product onto your face. They are nice and cool which is a treat for under your eyeballs. Please note that the product is actually tinted so a little bit goes a long way. The only thing I didn't like is that it did not really absorb into the skin (maybe it's the pigment), but it just sits on the face which you can see if you look closely and also it starts flaking off after a little while. I didn't see much of a difference after using this product.

I have been using this No7 Radiance+ roll eye cream for a few weeks now and I really like it. My undereye area can get very dark and tired looking and this has really been helping lighten that skin. The roller balls feel nice when applying the cream but I tend to still pat it onto my skin with a finger at the end to smooth it all out. It absorbs well into my skin and I like that it does not have a strong fragrance,. Works well!

avis.titre: Haven't seen much change yet but I am going to keep using
avis.texte: I received this as a free sample and have been using it daily. I can't say that I've noticed a difference yet but I'm going to keep at it. It goes on easily but I feel the need to rub it in a little after applying bc it comes out pretty thick. I like the concept of the product and am hopeful it will improve my under eyes.
